title: Kurt and Wyatt Russell Talk ‘Monarch: Legacy of Monsters’ Season 2 Return, Upcoming Spinoff and the Complicated Legacy of ‘Tombstone’
summary: "I'm more excited to start working on this than I have been about anything in a long time,” Wyatt tells The Hollywood Reporter of the forthcoming spinoff to Apple's father-and-son starring Monsterverse series, which returned on Friday with season two.
